summary: Iter44 — Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of new AzoApp Admin Analytics Dashboard (GET /api/admin/dashboard + /admin UI). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS covering shape, KPI/status_breakdown/combined_series arithmetic, completed==completed+paid, has_baseline gating for range=all, bucket echo (day/week/month/year), custom date range, filter narrowing, earnings arithmetic (net_revenue = platform_revenue - merchant_commission - refunds), Mongo _id exclusion, filters_available keys, 401/403 without token. Frontend: header (Analytics Dashboard, dash-updated timestamp), Export CSV (real .csv download 'azoapp-analytics-...csv'), Refresh (re-fetches), Filters (filter-status=completed applies API param, active chip shown, KPIs update), Donut click (donut-completed applies status filter), Calendar (opens, presets visible, dash-cal-title -> dash-cal-years -> dash-cal-year-2025 switch works, Apply/Cancel/Clear present, All Time preset hides deltas & shows 'all time' sub-text), all 27 data-testids present (kpi-grid, kpi-revenue/platform/bookings/completed/pending/cancelled/customers/partners/merchants/aov, dash-revenue-chart, dash-booking-trend, dash-status-donut, dash-ops, dash-attention, dash-earnings, dash-services (+svc-sort-*), dash-partners, dash-customers, dash-merchants, dash-qr, dash-cities (+city-sort-*), dash-recent (+rb-search/status/payment/service/day/prev/next/pagesize/showing)). Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390), KPI grid = 2 columns, no console errors, filters wrap. Real DB data throughout — 14 bookings all-time, 68 QR codes, 24 refunds, correct earnings arithmetic verified.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' ~14x on first load — ResponsiveContainer briefly gets 0 dims. Cosmetic only; charts render correctly after layout settles. Consider adding minHeight to the chart container to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height warnings by giving the chart wrappers an explicit minHeight to prevent the initial 0px measurement.

(Docs) Playbook mentioned testids 'svc-view-services' / 'svc-view-categories' but actual code emits 'svc-view-service' / 'svc-view-category' (singular via Seg testid+value). Not a bug — align docs or rename ids for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard_service.build() correctly aggregates from live collections; no hard-coded/seeded values found — matches contract.
Response is flat (KPIs at top-level) not nested under a 'kpis' key as the playbook wording implied; front-end code accesses them at top level so this is consistent — worth documenting.
earnings.net_revenue arithmetic (platform_revenue - merchant_commission - refunds) verified against API values.
combined_series bookings sum matches total_bookings within the selected window.
seed_data_creation: None — requirement is real data only. DB unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard endpoint takes 10-30s per call on the preview URL; use timeout>=60s in tests. KPI fields are at the top level of the JSON response (not nested under 'kpis'). status_breakdown is a list of {status,count}. has_baseline is False when range=all. Calendar year-grid testids follow pattern dash-cal-year-<YYYY>. Frontend correctly reads from /api/admin/dashboard and applies all filters via query params.
